purpose: Typed relationships for SignalTerrain topics. Connect naturally; never force denseness or attribution theater.

types.label: Affects
types.description: A condition or event impacts another topic.

types.label: Involves (literacy)
types.description: Campaign or actor literacy link to a vulnerability topic. Never stores exploit steps.

types.label: Advises on
types.description: Advisory or guidance about a topic.

types.label: Documents
types.description: Paper, RFC, or standard documents a topic.

types.label: Operates
types.description: Organization or actor operates a capability — awareness framing.

types.label: Uses protocol
types.description: System or service uses a protocol.
